case_desc.description: One line: the parties, and what the construction dispute was about.

clauses.description: The clauses the court construed. An empty list is a valid answer when the construed contract is not in the record.

clause_name.description: Short name including the section number, e.g. "Section 8 — Indemnity".

taxonomy.description: Which of the risk type codes listed in the task this clause carries. One of those codes and no other.

contract_id.description: The contract_id of the contract this clause came from, copied exactly from that document's START marker.

start_line.description: First line the clause occupies in that contract.

end_line.description: Last line the clause occupies in that contract.

head.description: The clause's first 8 words, copied EXACTLY as the lines show them. Do not repair the OCR here. If the whole clause is under 16 words, put all of it here.

tail.description: The clause's last 8 words, copied EXACTLY as the lines show them. Do not repair the OCR here. Empty string if the whole clause is already in head.

opinion_comment_start_line.description: First line in the OPINION of the passage where the court construes this clause.

opinion_comment_end_line.description: Last line in the OPINION of that passage.
